description:
Count this company's documents, and compare recent days.

The answer to "how many invoices this month", "how much did I
bill" and "is rejection going up": totals by document type and
by status over everything, then issued and rejected counts and
the amount for the last `days` beside the `days` before them,
and one row per day. In the connection's environment only.
Read-only.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit it if the connection covers a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit it if the connection covers a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

days.description: The window compared with the one before it, in days. 30 by default.

name: invoice_stats

PeriodSummary.description: Issued and rejected counts over one window.

outputSchema.description:
Counts of the company's documents, and the last days against the
ones before.

daily_series.description: One row per day: date, count, amount.
